answer: Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted reputation: each agent must lock a bond to earn a verified identity, and voting power is capped by proven history rather than raw account count. A lone island of fake identities gains nothing because every new account starts with zero trust, and forging a juniper-scented reputation trail costs real collateral. The single thread holding the system together is that identity, stake, and peer attestations are cryptographically linked, so each extra fake account multiplies attacker cost without multiplying influence.
